summary: Capability overlay naming apparatus seams where a declared, registered mutation may replace values. This is not a second trace registry: it never redefines #22 trace meanings, order or schemas, and it grants nothing to producers. Adding a writable seam requires a producer handoff that names the landed downstream refusal.

registry_binding.trace_ownership: #22/#23 remain the sole owners of trace meaning and passive capture; observers stay passive

apparatus.producer_call.summary: The apparatus fixture producer invocation that yields attempt payload bytes. A declared mutation may raise the identified ProducerCrash or return a replacement value; the Voice graph is never invoked here.
apparatus.producer_call.downstream: injection session in-band errored event; scorecard.make_report / case_registry.row_outcome refuse any PASS from an errored attempt

apparatus.artifact_write.summary: The apparatus write step that persists attempt payload bytes and returns the stored path/size/digest binding. A declared mutation may truncate or bit-flip the stored bytes so they diverge from the declared binding.
apparatus.artifact_write.downstream: artifacts.verify_sha256 refuses the stored bytes against the declared receipt digest

apparatus.receipt_append.summary: The apparatus step that emits the scorecard-shaped attempt receipt. A declared mutation may rebind the receipt digest to foreign bytes or drop the receipt from the attempt inventory.
apparatus.receipt_append.downstream: scorecard.validate_row refuses malformed receipts; mutations.require_complete_inventory refuses a shrunken denominator; artifacts.verify_sha256 refuses rebound digests

apparatus.evidence_digest.summary: Derived digest binding over already-produced bytes. This is a passive, derived observation and therefore not an executable injection seam; a plan declaring a mutation here must fail closed at registration.
apparatus.evidence_digest.downstream: mutations.validate_plan refuses any operator at a non-writable seam

board.partition_access.summary: The partition claim presented to the case registry access gate. A declared mutation may relabel the claim so the holdout refusal path is exercised as a test, never to actually read sealed payloads.
board.partition_access.downstream: case_registry._access refuses before any stat/read of holdout payloads; evaluate refuses unassigned partitions

capture.inventory.summary: The capture descriptor inventory presented to the landed capture validator. A declared mutation may swap or drop names so the capture refusal path is exercised against the #22 registry; passive observers themselves stay passive.
capture.inventory.downstream: trace_capture.validate_selected_capture refuses missing, extra, swapped or reordered capture inventories
